name: Fried Egg Sandwich with Cheddar, Avocado & Tomato-Cucumber Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into half-moons. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, gently crack eggs into the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
12 eggs
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, thinly slice cheddar.
Divide bread between two large baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until bread is toasted on one side, 1-2 minutes.

Remove baking sheets from the oven, flip bread, and arrange cheese over half of the slices. Working in batches, return baking sheets to the oven and continue to broil until bread is toasted and cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Layer each cheesy toast slice with two fried eggs and avocado. Spread mayo over remaining toast slices and place on top to close sandwiches.
To serve, divide sandwiches and salad between plates. Enjoy!
